it's not that the infrastructure is absent — it's that the test's self-deployed DRA driver setup is flaky in our environment.(hence we are seeing a failure rate of 47% and not 100%) Upstream didn't root-cause this either ([@pohly explicitly noted that](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137552#discussion_r2906856147)), they just moved the test to a dedicated lane where it's more reliable. So its okay for us to do the same.
